title: SendCredentialingOutreachRequest
description: Request body for sending a credentialing outreach email

workflowId.description: The workflow ID for the credentialing outreach. Required for single-workflow requests. When workflowIds is provided with more than one entry, this field is optional.

workflowIds.description: List of workflow IDs for multi-tenant outreach. When more than one entry is provided, initiatingWorkflowId must also be set. Single-workflow requests should leave this null and use workflowId instead.

initiatingWorkflowId.description: The workflow ID of the initiating org for multi-tenant outreach. Required when workflowIds contains more than one entry. Must be present in the workflowIds list. The initiating workflow's tenant outreach-settings template is applied to all bundled workflows.

toEmails.description: List of email addresses to send the outreach email to

ccEmails.description: Optional list of CC email addresses

bccEmails.description: Optional list of BCC email addresses

outreachReasons.description: List of reasons for the outreach

outreachReasonsWithLabels.description: List of outreach reasons with their display labels. When provided, labels are persisted with the outreach record.

OutreachReasonWithLabel.description: Outreach reason with ID and label

id.description: Unique identifier for the outreach reason

label.description: Display label for the outreach reason
